population: Mohenjo-daro seals joined to a Marshall 1931 table row with a numeric depth below the modern surface; one legend per object; strata are Marshall's area with the export's section where that cell has at least 15 seals with a depth, otherwise the area's remaining seals pooled; strata under 5 seals dropped; u is the depth rank within stratum scaled to (0, 1), 1 highest; identical complete legends in a stratum merged at median u. Both halves of the package's bench shots split are read after the freeze and pooled.
frozen_parameters: discovery-v2/frozen-parameters.json: closing stock (12 signs), closing formulae (25 final pairs), non-final sign height scores (120 signs), all from Mackay's DK-G seals

predictions.statistic: Share of legends (two or more signs, ordered, closing sign readable) that close in the closing stock, top third of u minus bottom third
predictions.null: Equivalence: 90% percentile interval from 9,999 stratified bootstrap resamples of legends
predictions.pass_rule: Interval inside (-0.20, 0.20) and stays inside after deleting, one at a time, each of the ten legends whose deletion moves the point estimate most (1,999 resamples each); otherwise inconclusive if the point estimate lies inside (-0.20, 0.20), fail if its absolute value is 0.20 or more
predictions.credence_effect: pass +0.05; inconclusive -0.03; fail kills the card

predictions.statistic: Share of bottom-third legends (u < 1/3) that close in the closing stock
predictions.pass_rule: Share at least 0.60, and at least 0.60 after deleting one bottom-third legend that closes in the stock

predictions.statistic: Share of legends whose final two signs form one of the 25 closing formulae, top third minus bottom third
Rank analysis of variance of u across opening-sign categories (signs opening at least 5 merged legends, others pooled): n times the between-category share of the variance of u
predictions.null: 9,999 permutations of u among legends within strata
predictions.pass_rule: One-sided p <= 0.05; and each of the ten legends whose deletion lowers the statistic most, deleted alone, leaves p <= 0.10 (2,999 permutations)
predictions.credence_effect: pass +0.08 (half if Holm-adjusted p over P4-P8 > 0.05); fail -0.06

predictions.statistic: z(opening) minus z(closing), the P4 statistic for opening and for closing signs on the same legends, each standardised by the mean and SD of its own permutation null
predictions.null: 9,999 joint permutations of u within strata applied to both positions

predictions.statistic: Sum over variant classes of the between-variant rank statistic minus its degrees of freedom; Wells codes mapped to exactly one Mayig class; classes with at least two codes of at least 3 tokens and at least 10 rows; one row per legend and class (its commonest code); all readable legends, identical complete legends merged
predictions.pass_rule: One-sided p <= 0.05 and the ten-deletion influence rule of P4

predictions.statistic: Correlation between within-stratum rank of legend length and u, complete legends of any length
predictions.pass_rule: Correlation > 0 with one-sided p <= 0.05 and the ten-deletion influence rule of P4

predictions.statistic: Pearson correlation between u and the mean DK-G height score of the legend's non-final signs (legends of two or more signs with at least one scored non-final sign)
predictions.pass_rule: One-sided p <= 0.05 and the ten-deletion influence rule of P4

predictions.statistic: Pearson correlation between u and an indicator of a rectangular seal (SEAL:R), all seals in strata
predictions.pass_rule: One-sided p <= 0.05 and the ten-deletion influence rule of P4

joint_credence_rule: C-0006 credence after the test = 0.20 + the effects of P1-P8 (a drift pass in P4-P8 counts half when its Holm-adjusted p over P4-P8 exceeds 0.05; P9 has no effect), held within [0.02, 0.90]. The card is dead at 0.02 if P1 fails (top-minus-bottom closing-stock share of absolute value 0.20 or more) or if P4, P5, P6 and P7 all fail. Status is strengthened if the result exceeds 0.20, weakened otherwise.
influence_rule: A pass requires the single-deletion check stated in each prediction; leave-one-stratum-out results are reported without changing an outcome.
sensitivity: Reported, not deciding: ranks within Marshall's area letters alone; each loader half scored separately with 1,999 draws.
